description: Public entry pages of gov.br digital services measured with Lighthouse. Only public pages are listed: no login is performed, no form is submitted, no personal data is sent.

services.name: Meu INSS
services.notes: Public landing page of the INSS self-service SPA. Login is not performed.

services.name: Receita Federal (e-CAC)
services.notes: Public entry page of e-CAC. Only the page load is measured; credentials are never entered. First curl probe on 2026-11-17 timed out (HTTP 000); second probe returned 200.

services.name: Carteira de Trabalho Digital (web)
services.notes: Web channel of CTPS Digital, served by the Portal Emprega Brasil SPA. The gov.br service page (https://www.gov.br/pt-br/servicos/obter-a-carteira-de-trabalho) links to this URL. https://servicos.mte.gov.br/ redirects here.

services.name: Portal da Transparência
services.notes: CGU transparency portal. Fully public content.

services.name: Meu SUS Digital
services.notes: Public landing page of Meu SUS Digital (Ministério da Saúde). Login is not performed.

services.name: Portal MG (serviços do Governo de Minas)
services.notes: Replacement for Detran-MG (see 'replaced'). Web channel of Minas Gerais state services, the web counterpart of the MG App.

services.name: Portal do Servidor
services.notes: Federal civil servant portal (Plone-based, same platform as Portal gov.br).

services.name: ENEM (Inep)
services.notes: https://enem.inep.gov.br/ redirects here (1 redirect on 2026-11-17). The final URL is measured directly so the redirect does not add time to the metrics.

replaced.reason: The URL redirects to https://meususdigital.saude.gov.br/ (Conecte SUS was succeeded by Meu SUS Digital). Keeping it would measure the same page twice.

robots.txt (HTTP 200) has 'User-agent: *' + 'Disallow: /' (only Googlebot and bedrockbot are allowed). Raw copy kept in data/robots/www.detran.mg.gov.br.txt. https://transito.mg.gov.br/ redirects to the same host.

replaced.candidate: Senatran - Portal de Serviços (considered as Detran-MG replacement)
replaced.reason: robots.txt request got no HTTP response (curl status 000), i.e. unreachable; RFC 9309 says assume full disallow, so it was not used.
